Description:
Experience refined West Coast living in this custom-built luxury residence by renowned builder Brandes, quietly tucked in Point Grey’s prestigious North of 4th pocket. Designed around a thoughtful reverse floor plan, the home elevates daily living with an open-concept main floor boasting soaring 11'+ vaulted ceilings and sweeping, uninterrupted water views. A private elevator seamlessly serves all three levels, providing effortless access throughout. Crafted for the culinary enthusiast and entertainer alike, the residence features a chef's kitchen fitted with premium Sub-Zero and Wolf appliances, honed granite counters, custom millwork, an expansive wine cellar, and a private home theater. Step outside to an entertainment-scale rooftop deck complete with a private hot tub and dramatic 360-degree views of the ocean, mountains, and city skyline. Appointed with custom stone, marble, and full high-tech home automation, this unfurnished 4-bedroom, 5-bathroom sanctuary effortlessly blends classic architectural warmth with modern sophistication—all just steps from Spanish Banks, Jericho Beach, UBC, and top-tier school catchments, including Lord Byng Secondary and Queen Mary Elementary.
